items.source: Creates a new ConverterBuilder.ReadingConverterBuilder to produce a converter to read values of the given source (the store type) into the given target (the domain type).
items.translation: 创建一个ConverterBuilder.ReadingConverterBuilder，用于生成一个转换器，将给定源（存储类型）的值读取到给定目标（领域类型）。

items.source: General purpose conversion framework to read objects from a data store abstraction and write it back.
items.translation: 通用转换框架，用于从数据存储抽象中读取对象并将其写回。
ConverterBuilder.ReadingConverterBuilder 在 org.springframework.data.convert 中的用途
